entities.name: Corona Rintawan
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Corona Rintawan is an Indonesian physician specializing in emergency medicine. Active in the field since 2003, he has led the NGO Muhammadiyah's medical response team in multiple disasters, most recently the COVID-19 pandemic.
